hints.title: Forward and Backward Partitioning
hints.text: Every stone except the first and last can be visited at most once across the entire round trip.

hints.title: Alternate Stone Routing
hints.text: To minimize the maximum step, alternate intermediate stones between the forward path and the return path.

hints.title: Step Size Upper Bound
hints.text: The maximum distance between consecutive stones on either path is bounded by stones[i] - stones[i - 2].

hints.title: Alternate Hop Computation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass over the sorted stones array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of stone visit orders takes factorial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that alternating stones between forward and backward passes is optimal.
